calculation.description: At each date, fade each instrument's five-day return relative to the cross-sectional median, scaling by its trailing 20-day daily-return volatility. Positive values indicate relatively weak recent performers and therefore a contrarian long signal. All inputs are lag-safe at the decision date.

validation.regime_notes: The available persisted price history covers the online period only (171 valid daily observations); all 15 tradable instruments were valid on these observations. Results clear the benchmark gates but uncertainty is elevated because the sample does not span the full warm-up regimes. Revalidate with expanded history when available.
